items.title: Hearing appointment in the guardianship proceedings (Anhörungstermin)
items.quote:
Der Termin findet am Donnerstag, 21.01.2027, 13:30 Uhr, im
Pflegeheim „Am Brockenblick“, Zimmer 12, statt.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date and time for the hearing, so no period calculation is needed; the date is simply taken as written. (21.01.2027 falls on a Thursday, matching the letter's own weekday label.) Attendance is stated to be desired but not compulsory ('Ihr Erscheinen ist erwünscht, aber nicht erzwingbar'), so this is an invitation to a hearing rather than an enforceable deadline, but the date itself is fixed and certain.

warnings: Attendance at the hearing is explicitly optional ('erwünscht, aber nicht erzwingbar'); the recipient may instead submit his view in writing if he cannot attend, so missing the appointment itself creates no legal deadline violation.
The letter contains no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung (legal remedy instructions), consistent with it being a hearing notice rather than a decision.
